title: DevX snippet scrapbook — evening log
content:
Quick evening brain dump (working list + tiny reproductions). Mostly half-formed — leave as my scratchpad until I turn into a PR/Confluence page.

Context: triaging small doc gaps and a couple of sample-app issues reported by support this morning. Goal for tomorrow: ship one small patch (python streaming example) + outline sample-app scaffold for VectorStore Firestore quickstart.

Top-of-mind TODOs (priority order):
- [ ] Fix python streaming example in `docs/getting-started/streaming.md` — missing `await` on client.stream_generate, causing traceback in v0.12.
  - Repro (local):
    1) pip install redwood-sdk==0.12.3 (or use local wheel)
    2) run example from streaming.md: `python stream_example.py`
    3) observe `RuntimeWarning: coroutine 'Client.stream_generate' was never awaited` then exit
  - Quick fix: add `asyncio.run(main())` wrapper in example or change to synchronous sample using `client.generate` if we want non-async docs.
  - PR idea: keep both variants (sync + async) with short callout about event loop.

- [ ] Sample-app: VectorStore: Firestore quickstart sketch (customer asked for non-Postgres example)
  - Requirements: python, google-cloud-firestore, redwood-sdk
  - Minimal flow: ingest text -> embed -> upsert to Firestore (vector store as base64 + metadata) -> simple query -> nearest-neighbor via client.embeddings+local similarity or Firestore query with kNN (if using Firestore managed kNN in beta)
  - Starter file list: `firestore_quickstart/README.md`, `ingest.py`, `query.py`, `requirements.txt`, `sample_env.env`
  - UX notes: keep under 300 LOC, include cost/latency note for small vs large models, show pinning to hosted vs dedicated endpoints.

- [ ] Docs alignment: CLI flags inconsistent between `docs/cli.md` and `sdk/cli/README.md` (seen `--region` vs `--geo`). Sweep and normalize to `--region` and list aliases.

Fragmented notes / weird snippets:
- Observed oddness in snippet on line 43 of `hello-world.md`: we show `client.generate({prompt: prompt})` (JS) but surrounding code uses `await client.generate({input: prompt})` — unify to `input:` across code samples.
- Customer repro for streaming: report included traceback and timestamp; slack thread: <https://app.slack.com/client/T12345/CDEVX/thread/1700000000.000100> (see linked_artifacts).
- Potential doc blurb: "When to pick Dedicated vs Hosted: latency predictability vs cost flexibility" — move to 1-paragraph FAQ in every quickstart where model selection matters.

Ideas for followups (not blocking):
- Add tiny visuals (ASCII) showing request routing when fallback triggers (hosted -> dedicated fallback flow). Good for console/rollouts docs.
- Collect 3 small eval prompts to add to VectorStore sample to catch regressions (one long, one multi-turn, one numeric extraction).
- Consider putting a `samples/` directory with short runnable snippets we can `curl` to run quickly in GH Actions smoke tests.

Notes to self before I sleep:
- Draft PR for python streaming fix first thing. Keep changes minimal. Title: "docs: fix python streaming example (await)". Link in ticket INF-1402.
- Sketch Firestore quickstart skeleton in a sandbox repo branch `devx/firestore-quickstart` after PR merges.
- Ping Jordan for quick sanity-check on the k/v format we recommend for Firestore vectors (base64 vs float arrays).
- Remove TODOs that become stale after patch.

Loose questions / unresolved:
- Does Dedicated support Firestore-hosted vector indexes? (ask infra/product)
- Should we add a short table comparing sample-app storage options (Firestore, Postgres, Pinecone, Weaviate) with cost/latency bullets? Good candidate for Optimize to reference.

Random tiny snippets I want to keep: 
- "If you're seeing a coroutine not awaited, check whether the example is intended for an async runtime."
- small perf note: "embedding calls single-threaded on CPU can be ~4-6x slower than batched GPU calls; recommend batch size 32 for small test workloads."

End of dump. Tomorrow: 1) PR for streaming, 2) outline firestore quickstart scaffold, 3) CLI flags sweep.

---
Local quick links:
- GH clone quick: `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/redwood-docs.git && git checkout -b fix/streaming-py`
- Repro snippet file: `examples/streaming/py/stream_example.py`
- Jira: INF-1402 (docs streaming sample failure), DOCS-321 (cli flags consistency)
short_summary: Evening personal DevX scratchpad: TO-DO list for small docs fixes, sample-app Firestore quickstart sketch, repro steps, and follow-ups.
